If your mail provider is Microsoft, they're dealing with a global outage of their services including email. https://www.theregister.com/saas/2026/11/13/microsofts-massive-m365-outage-stretches-past-20-hours-as-its-fixes-keep-failing/5309609

There has been some recent reports of issues following deletion of emails however none exactly as you describe.

https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/questions/1613778 https://forum.k9mail.app/t/some-read-emails-hidden-from-k9-only/14620

Thunderbird for Android v25 was released a few days ago. If your running an older version, can you try upgrading and check if the problem persists.

If it does, please open an issue ticket on github linked below. https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/issues

If possible, Please capture a debug log and attach it to the report. See the below guide. https://thunderbird.github.io/thunderbird-android/docs/latest/user-guide/troubleshooting/collecting-debug-logs.html
